method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Common Hud constructs this front safe-area wrapper directly. Builds playercard, ability callout queue and prone-blocked help child. MPSplitscreen requires IsMultiplayer and IsSplitscreenAndInGame; lobbyNav notifications reevaluate state. CallOriginalSecond close registers self.__onClose, whose unselected outside body is a dependency. Optional postload then self return. Does not itself establish screen-safe coordinates or child gameplay subscriptions.

summary.answer: Creates an AbilityCallout_Queue UIElement and subscribes PerController.scriptNotify. Delivery forwards the original model to AddToAbilityCalloutQueue(self,controller,model), without filtering the event here. Optional PostLoadFunc runs before SetupAbilityCalloutQueue(self,controller,menu), then self is returned. Queue filtering/dispatch/teardown belongs to the external helper; no close/reset body is selected here.
